candidate_concepts.label: Equally Likely (Laplace) Criterion
candidate_concepts.description: Decision rule that selects the alternative with the highest average payoff, assuming all states of nature are equally probable.

candidate_concepts.label: Realism (Hurwicz) Criterion
candidate_concepts.description: Decision rule that selects the alternative with the highest weighted average of its best and worst payoffs, using a coefficient of realism α to reflect optimism (α close to 1) or pessimism (α close to 0).
coverage_criteria: Student can define the realism criterion
Student can interpret the coefficient α
Student can compute weighted averages using α*best + (1-α)*worst and identify the optimal choice

extraction_reason.source_grounded_rationale: The video explains the realism approach as a compromise between best and worst, introduces α, interprets its value, and calculates weighted averages for all alternatives.
extraction_reason.granularity_rationale: This is an appropriate concept size as it encapsulates a complete decision rule with its parameter and computation method.
